lines.trans: Tell me, do you feel like going out to eat with me today?
That's why I'm asking you today! And of course you say yes.
Morning! How can I help you two? What's up?
The numbers don't look good, and he doesn't know the details.
Nonsense, that's not true, of course I know what's going on!
That fifteen-thousand-euro surplus from last month, where did that come from?
The money saved you! Without the money it would all be over already.
Yes, because of the pome fruit! In summer pome fruit sells great, especially in June.
